title: Cargo enables features nothing uses
body:
Checked by removing each feature in a scratch copy and running `cargo check --all-targets`.

| crate | feature | finding |
|---|---|---|
| tokio | `rt-multi-thread`, `macros`, `time` | unused: the only runtime is `new_current_thread`, and there is no `#[tokio::main]`, `#[tokio::test]` or `tokio::time` use |
| smithay | `desktop` | no `smithay::desktop` import; `send_frames_surface_tree` in `compositor.rs` is a hand-written copy of the helper under it |
| smithay | `backend_egl` | implied by `renderer_gl` and `backend_gbm` |
| wayland-protocols | `staging`, `unstable` | compiles without them; smithay and sctk turn them on |
| rustix | `event`, `fs` | used by `script.rs` and `control.rs`, but compiles without them through unification |

Removing any of these fails: calloop `signals`, sctk `calloop`, smithay `backend_gbm` and `renderer_gl`, rustix `net` and `process`, axum `http1` and `tokio`. Every dependency has a user. The redundant-by-unification rows are a judgment call, since keeping them records what the code uses.

## Proposal

`tokio = { features = ["rt", "net", "sync"] }`. Drop smithay's `desktop`, or use its `send_frames_surface_tree` in place of the copy if its throttling arguments fit a nested compositor.
